g.text: Where Does Your Organization Actually Stand?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Honest self-assessment before committing to an AI roadmap

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Level 4 — AI Scaling: data flywheel running, models retraining on real usage, moat widening

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Example: GitHub Copilot team — continuous deployment, A/B testing models, retraining on accepted/rejected suggestions.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Level 3 — AI Capable: first model live in production, team learning from real traffic

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Example: Intercom early AI — basic intent classifier live, team debugging real production failures and edge cases daily.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Level 2 — AI Ready: data clean, infrastructure in place, first hire made, pilot running

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Example: A startup with clean event logs, a data scientist onboarded, and a recommendation prototype running in staging.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Level 1 — AI Aware: leadership aligned, use cases identified, gaps understood

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Example: Leadership has approved an AI roadmap. No team hired yet. Data quality unknown. Still in planning.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Level 0 — AI Curious: interested but no data, no plan, no committed budget

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Example: Exec says we need to do AI this year. No specifics. No owner. No timeline. Sound familiar?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Most organizations are at Level 0-1. Reach Level 2 before your Q1 2026 roadmap means anything at all.
